title: The Derma Co — Q4 Sunscreen Line Expansion & Quick Commerce Strategy

segments.transcript:
[Varun Alagh]: Welcome everyone. Let's look at the quarterly performance for The Derma Co sunscreen range, specifically our 1% Hyaluronic Aqua Gel. As you know, consumer demand on Blinkit and Zepto has surged 40% month-on-month.
[Ghazal Alagh]: Yes, but our customer care team is noticing in the recent KYC calls that users in South India want larger pack sizes. They are currently buying two 50g packs a month. We need to fast-track the 80g SKU launch.
[Head of R&D]: The stability and SPF 50+ in-vivo verification for the 80g pump format is already complete with CTRI registration. The viscosity and preservative efficacy tests show zero degradation even at 45 degrees Celsius.
[Quick Commerce Lead]: From the supply chain side, our dark store fill rate in Bangalore and Hyderabad is at 94%. If we launch the 80g variant, we need at least 3 weeks of safety stock in the Bhiwandi and Nelamangala mother hubs.
[Meeting Note Added]: Simulated 10-minute team exchange
segments.summary: The executive team reviewed Q3 performance for The Derma Co sunscreen portfolio, identifying strong quick-commerce tailwinds and verified South India consumer demand for larger 80g packaging. R&D confirmed full formulation stability and CTRI SPF certification.
keyPoints: Blinkit & Zepto quick commerce sales up 40% MoM
Consumer feedback from South KYC strongly demands 80g value format
R&D completed stability and preservative efficacy verification at 45°C
Warehouse safety stock required for Bhiwandi and Nelamangala fulfillment centers
decisions: Approved immediate commercial production ramp-up for 80g Hyaluronic Sunscreen SKU.
Allocated initial 30,000 units exclusively to quick-commerce dark stores in Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Delhi NCR.

actionItems.task: Release final packaging artwork with ISO 24444:2019 test seal
Coordinate mother hub inventory transfer for 30k units

summary:
The meeting focused on the strategic expansion of The Derma Co's sunscreen portfolio, driven by strong Q4 performance and new product development. Discussions centered on addressing immediate consumer demand for larger pack sizes and leveraging a promising new tinted matte gel sunscreen prototype.

The 1% Hyaluronic Aqua Gel sunscreen demonstrated a significant 40% month-on-month surge in demand via quick commerce platforms like Blinkit and Zepto. A key insight from customer feedback, particularly in South India, highlighted a strong preference for larger pack sizes, with users currently purchasing multiple 50g units. R&D confirmed the readiness of an 80g pump format, having completed all necessary stability, SPF 50+ in-vivo verification, and CTRI registration, showing robust performance even at 45 degrees Celsius. The Quick Commerce team confirmed a 94% dark store fill rate in key southern cities but emphasized the need for a three-week safety stock in main mother hubs prior to the 80g SKU launch.

Attention then shifted to a new tinted matte gel sunscreen prototype, which received overwhelmingly positive feedback (88% approval) from dermatologists for its zero-white-cast finish on FitzPatrick skin types IV and V. This breakthrough presents a significant opportunity to reduce customer acquisition costs (CAC) by positioning it as an all-in-one daily primer with broad-spectrum protection. A critical strategic directive was to maintain a strict fragrance-free claim, aligning with Derma Co's brand promise for sensitive skin. The CEO also set a clear price ceiling of under ₹599 to ensure competitive volume velocity against international brands.
keyTopics: Q4 Performance and Demand for The Derma Co 1% Hyaluronic Aqua Gel Sunscreen: Noted a 40% MoM surge in demand on quick commerce platforms, with specific consumer feedback from South India indicating a strong preference for larger pack sizes.

Launch of 80g SKU for 1% Hyaluronic Aqua Gel Sunscreen: R&D confirmed the readiness of an 80g pump format, including stability, SPF 50+ in-vivo verification, and CTRI registration. Supply chain readiness requires 3 weeks of safety stock in Bhiwandi and Nelamangala mother hubs.

Development and Market Potential of Tinted Matte Gel Sunscreen Prototype: A new formulation received 88% positive feedback from dermatologists for its zero-white-cast finish. This product is seen as a potential CAC reducer if positioned as an all-in-one primer and broad-spectrum protector, with a critical need to maintain a fragrance-free claim and a price point under ₹599.
decisions: Approved to fast-track the launch of the 80g SKU for The Derma Co 1% Hyaluronic Aqua Gel sunscreen.
Agreed to maintain a strict fragrance-free claim for the new tinted matte gel sunscreen prototype.
Decided to price the tinted matte gel sunscreen under ₹599 to ensure volume velocity and competitiveness.

actionItems.task: Expedite the launch of the 80g SKU for The Derma Co 1% Hyaluronic Aqua Gel sunscreen.
Ensure 3 weeks of safety stock for the 80g sunscreen variant in Bhiwandi and Nelamangala mother hubs.
Develop and refine the marketing and positioning strategy for the tinted matte gel sunscreen, highlighting its all-in-one primer and broad-spectrum protection benefits.
Ensure the final formulation of the tinted matte gel sunscreen strictly adheres to the fragrance-free claim.
Finalize the pricing strategy for the tinted matte gel sunscreen to ensure it remains under ₹599.

--- [Segment 1 | 00:00 - 10:00] ---

[Varun Alagh]: Welcome everyone. Let's look at the quarterly performance for The Derma Co sunscreen range, specifically our 1% Hyaluronic Aqua Gel. As you know, consumer demand on Blinkit and Zepto has surged 40% month-on-month.
[Ghazal Alagh]: Yes, but our customer care team is noticing in the recent KYC calls that users in South India want larger pack sizes. They are currently buying two 50g packs a month. We need to fast-track the 80g SKU launch.
[Dr. Ananya]: The stability and SPF 50+ in-vivo verification for the 80g pump format is already complete with CTRI registration. The viscosity and preservative efficacy tests show zero degradation even at 45 degrees Celsius.
[Rajesh K.]: From the supply chain side, our dark store fill rate in Bangalore and Hyderabad is at 94%. If we launch the 80g variant, we need at least 3 weeks of safety stock in the Bhiwandi and Nelamangala mother hubs.

[Dr. Ananya]: Moving to the next formulation agenda: the tinted matte gel sunscreen prototype. In our internal panel of 45 dermatologists, 88% praised the zero-white-cast finish on FitzPatrick skin types IV and V.

[Priya S.]: For the upcoming summer influencer activation, we analyzed 120 Instagram reels through our Reel Intelligence Analyzer. Educational dermatologist reels showing UV camera comparisons generated 3.4x higher conversion than lifestyle influencer videos.
[Varun Alagh]: Let's reallocate 60% of our creator budget to verified medical influencers and cosmetic chemists who can articulate the PA++++ protection factor and in-vivo testing standards.
[Rajesh K.]: We also need co-marketing banners on Blinkit during morning commute hours (8 AM - 11 AM) when UV index alerts are highest.
summary:
The executive leadership team met to review The Derma Co's sunscreen market expansion, formulation roadmap, and rapid distribution through quick-commerce channels. 

Key strategic milestones achieved during the session:
1. Approved commercial ramp-up of the high-demand 80g Hyaluronic Sunscreen value format, backed by CTRI in-vivo verification and zero heat-degradation stability data.
2. Greenlit the 500-participant clinical trial for the new Tinted Matte Sunscreen prototype tailored specifically for Indian skin tones.
3. Reallocated digital marketing and influencer budgets toward medical-led UV camera education, optimizing blended CAC.
